requirements.requirement: A healthy three-member etcd cluster runs on node1, node2, and node3.
requirements.summary: Membership directly lists the three named voting members. Final health and status show all three endpoints healthy, running etcd 3.7.1, and converged at Raft term 2 and applied index 24.

requirements.requirement: Client and peer traffic is protected with mutual TLS.
requirements.summary: Plaintext client access and TLS connections without client certificates were rejected, including the peer port, while an authenticated client succeeded. All three member certificates validate under the private CA and contain matching SANs plus client/server authentication usages.
The write succeeded, and final linearizable reads—including directly from returned node3—show the required key with value ready.

requirements.requirement: Node4 is available for cluster administration and backups.
requirements.summary: Authenticated administrative commands executed from node4 successfully queried all members and performed cluster writes. Node4 also has an enabled, active snapshot timer and functional snapshot tooling.

requirements.requirement: A current recovery snapshot is left on node4.
requirements.summary: A final mode-0600 snapshot was created after the outage-time write, passed its checksum and status checks at revision 3, restored successfully into an isolated etcd instance, and returned both the required key and the outage-time write.

requirements.requirement: The cluster continues serving consistent reads and writes with one member unavailable, then returns that member with current data.
requirements.summary: A healthy baseline was observed, node3 was stopped with its listeners absent, and node1/node2 continued serving linearizable reads and committed a new write. After node3 restarted, a direct linearizable read from it returned that outage-time write, and all three endpoints recovered healthy at the same applied index.

overall_summary: All material outcomes are satisfied with direct behavioral evidence: the three-member mTLS cluster is healthy, the required data and usable current snapshot exist, node4 provides administration and backup capability, and a bounded one-member outage demonstrated continued consistent service and full resynchronization.
limitations: The bounded disruption exercised node3 specifically; node1 and node2 were not separately failed.

Unauthenticated and plaintext rejection probes targeted node1, while coverage of node2 and node3 relies on their validated certificates, identical service posture, and successful secured cluster operation.

operational_hygiene.summary: No executor-caused failed services or package-health problems were observed. The required etcd listeners are bound only to member addresses, sensitive keys and snapshots have restrictive permissions, and the temporary restore instance, files, and listeners were removed after testing.
